_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing a polite way to say there is no hurry

segments.text: It means, there is no hurry.
I am not ready yet. Take your time!
Repeat after me. Take your time.

native.caption: تريد أن تقول لصديقك «خذ وقتك»؟ قل “Take your time” – أي لا داعي للعجلة، وهي عبارة لطيفة وطبيعية. مثال: “I am not ready yet.” – “Take your time!”. استمع إلى المعلمة Ama ثم كرّر في لحظة الصمت. تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: How do you say “take your time” in English?
en.caption: Want to tell a friend there is no hurry? Say “Take your time” – it is kind and natural. Example: “I am not ready yet.” – “Take your time!”. Listen to Ama, then say it in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
